automatic_ridges_included: Every proposed ridge, unchanged; fail closed on no events or excessive work rather than screening for a successful result
grid_method: Inclusive rectangular endpoints; degree steps from111320m per degree and cosine of midpoint latitude, no truth-centered point
measurement_sigma: Native reported ridge frequency/time uncertainty unchanged; common frequency residual scale1Hz
refinement: No automatic refinement is declared here. The coarse result and alternatives must first be reported; later refinement is a separately recorded source-informed experiment.
review_semantics: Pending operator workspace is preserved. A separate experiment copy includes every unedited proposal only for numerical validation. Its confirmed flag is an API eligibility flag in the experiment, not a claim of human review or aircraft identity.
